about_the_game:
Step into Ayana, a cozy turn-based flower shop simulator where every day brings new choices and challenges. Strategically place tiles to build your town map and plan your inventory using daily bouquet forecasts. Stock up on fresh supplies from a merchant who visits once per day, then craft stunning bouquets with a single click.

Build your card deck as each day unfolds in turns: use your limited energy each round to serve customers, play cards to boost profits, or manage both friendly and unwelcome guests. When your turn ends, customers acts and their patience will decrease—then it’s back to you. Serve customers quickly before their patience runs out. Balance your actions carefully to keep your reputation growing.

Key Features:

- Tile-based map building: Strategically place tiles to create your town map.

- Deck-building strategy: Build and play the deck of cards to gain advantages and manage every situation.

- Turn-based flower shop game play: Every round, use energy to serve, strategize, and react.

- Forecast-driven planning: Use daily trends to plan your inventory and deck.

- Merchant mechanics: Purchase supplies from a visiting merchant—choose wisely!

- Customer service: Serve bouquets before patience runs out for maximum profit.

- Eventful days: Manage both welcome and unwelcome guests.

- Reputation system: Keep your reputation high to stay in business—if it drops to the lowest level, it’s game over. Aim to complete the ultimate 3-star event's order for victory!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU running Vulkan via MoltenVK
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Recent Metal-capable GPU (runs Vulkan via MoltenVK)
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 64-bit CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • VR Support: Not Supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Mid-range GPU with Vulkan 1.x support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: Not Supported
